content_fixes.new: Now, what's real freedom? Just because we're not under the old rules, does that mean we can just do whatever we want? Since we have God's freedom, can we just follow every impulse? Not a chance. You know from your own life that some of the things that feel like freedom actually wreck your freedom. If you hand yourself over to sin, that's your last free choice. But if you hand yourself over to God's ways, the freedom never runs out. Think about it: back when you did whatever you felt like, not caring about God or anyone else, your life just got worse and your freedom shrank. And look at you now, living in God's freedom, your life healed and wide open. What did all that wild living get you anyway? Nothing you're proud of now. It got you nowhere. Working for sin your whole life pays out exactly one thing: death. But God's gift? Real life, forever life, delivered by Jesus, our Master.
